ios.desc:
Experience Hacker News like never before with our new app!

Take full advantage of your iOS device to:
* Explore the Top 100 Hacker News stories in innovative ways: filter by Rank, Points, or Comments.
* Enjoy fully responsive text sizes that cater to your reading comfort.
* Share the articles that resonate with you across all your favorite social platforms.
* Quickly hide stories from your feed with a simple swipe to the left!
* Immerse yourself in ad-free reading with built-in reader mode.
* Switch to dark mode for comfortable reading day or night.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Helvetica Neue – Sortable / Filterable Hacker News Built with Firebase

quotes.text:
Actually, I have had an iOS app using the client out for about 3 weeks. It was meant to be a tutorial on how to use Couchbase Lite to consume APIs. However, it's going through a complete rewrite to make it full featured. I use it to consume Hacker News. I have a version that allows me to sort and hide stories I've already read that is waiting for approval.

Github: https://github.com/wrkstrm/HelveticaNeue

App Store: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/helvetica-neue-native-open/id931789125?mt=8
